vision.hero.title: Our Vision & Mission
vision.hero.subtitle: Building a spiritually awakened society rooted in Dharma and devotion
vision.section1.title: Our Mission & Vision
vision.intro: The organization envisions a world where spiritual values guide everyday life, where devotion to Lord Ram becomes a living practice, and where service to humanity is the highest form of worship.
vision.feature1.title: Preservation of Bhaktamal Heritage
vision.feature1.desc: Safeguarding and promoting the sacred Bhaktamal tradition and Vaishnav philosophy for future generations
vision.feature2.title: Global Promotion of Shri Ram Bhakti
vision.feature2.desc: Spreading the message of Lord Ram's devotion and teachings across India and the world
vision.feature3.title: Service-Oriented Spiritual Development
vision.feature3.desc: Integrating selfless service (Seva) as the foundation of spiritual growth and community welfare
vision.feature4.title: Establishing Ayodhya as a Global Center of Dharma
vision.feature4.desc: Making Ayodhya a beacon of spiritual learning and Sanatan Dharma for devotees worldwide
vision.section2.title: Our Core Values
vision.value1.title: Faith
vision.value1.desc: Unwavering devotion to Lord Ram and the teachings of our spiritual tradition
vision.value2.title: Discipline
vision.value2.desc: Following the righteous path with dedication and spiritual discipline
vision.value3.title: Service
vision.value3.desc: Selfless service to saints, devotees, and all beings
vision.value4.title: Compassion
vision.value4.desc: Extending kindness and support to all who seek spiritual guidance
vision.value5.title: Scriptural Authenticity
vision.value5.desc: Maintaining the purity and authenticity of traditional teachings
vision.value6.title: Community Welfare
vision.value6.desc: Working towards the spiritual and material well-being of society
vision.foundation.title: Our Spiritual Foundation
vision.foundation.p1: Bada Bhaktmaal Ashram stands not only as a place of worship, but as a living spiritual institution dedicated to devotion, tradition, and humanitarian service in the sacred land of Ayodhya. Through Shri Ram devotion, Vaishnav saint tradition, Bhajan, Kirtan & Satsang culture, and scriptural study, we strive to create a spiritually awakened society where Dharma guides life and devotion becomes a daily practice.
vision.foundation.p2: Seva (selfless service) is the highest expression of our devotion. We believe that serving humanity is serving the divine, and through Annadan, Gaushala Seva, and spiritual guidance, we work to uplift both the spiritual and material well-being of all who come to us.
vision.cta.title: Join Our Mission
vision.cta.desc: Be part of our vision to create a spiritually awakened society rooted in devotion and service
